# Every piece

240 pieces. The name is what `<Ascii piece="…">`, `<ascii-art piece="…">`, and `npx ascii.rest …` take; the export is what `import { … } from "ascii.rest/pieces"` gives. A **canvas** piece has colours of its own and draws on a `<canvas>`: size it with `width`. A **text** piece draws in a `<pre>` in the page's colour: size it with `font-size`. Options are the piece's own, with their defaults; pass them as `options`. Each piece plays at https://ascii.rest/<name>/. Only logos, companies and distros have hosted README SVGs, at https://ascii.rest/svg/<name>.svg and .dark.svg; any other piece needs `svg()` from `ascii.rest/svg` and a committed file.
